description.value:
In public, you are a courtier, a mediator, or an entertainer. Behind that glamorous facade lies a mind trained to gather secrets. Taught by the enchanters of the Bejeweled Conclave, you know how to use your charm, your wit, and a little magic to infiltrate organizations, uncover information, and broker deals.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.3zef3lYcVqgEVCPP]{Arcane Eloquence}

Skill Proficiencies: Deception and Perception

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPerfume0000]{Perfume}, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP

QCXGhp92ds3kpW55.title: Background Ability Score Improvement
QCXGhp92ds3kpW55.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
